content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tohoku_tsunami case that plots two tsunami surface-elevation snapshots (eta_00002 at 1 hr and eta_00009 at 8 hr) in stacked subplots over the 30-arcmin Pacific grid. It loads depth_30min.txt for masking and grid sizing (L4, L6), builds lon/lat at 0.5-degree spacing with origins 132.01667/-59.98333 (L7-L10), selects snapshots nfile=[2 9] labeled hr={'1' '8'} (L13-L14), and sets a 5x7-inch figure (L16-L19). Per snapshot (L22-L48): loads eta_<fnum> from fdir (L24-L25), NaNs land where dep<0 (L27), draws pcolor(x,y,eta) with flat shading (L29-L31), titles ' Time = <hr> hr ' (L34), applies caxis [-0.5 0.5] for the first panel and [-0.05 0.05] for later panels overriding an initial [-0.1 0.1] (L33, L36-L40), labels Lat/Lon, adds a colorbar labeled eta (m), and forces zbuffer (L42-L46). A commented jpeg export line remains at L49.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
hr — cell array of hour labels {'1' '8'} (L14)
eta — surface elevation per snapshot, land NaN-ed (L25, L27)

equations.ref: masking land cells (negative depth) before plotting

io.name: stacked pcolor panels of eta at 1 hr and 8 hr with colorbars

unresolved: The mapping nfile=[2 9] to hours {'1' '8'} (L13-L14) implies snapshot k corresponds to (k-1) hours, i.e. a 3600 s output interval; this must match the case input, not verifiable here.
caxis([-0.1 0.1]) (L33) is immediately overridden by the if/else at L36-L40 every iteration, so it is dead code.
fdir (L2) is a hardcoded developer path while dep comes from the repo-relative path (L4); the two data sources must correspond to the same run for the masking at L27 to be valid.
